summary.result: An experiment on spatial downscaling of coarse scale land surface temperature products demonstrated that this tool could generate downscaling results in which overall variations in input coarse scale data were preserved and local details were also well captured.
summary.background: Spatial downscaling is often applied to coarse scale satellite products with high temporal resolution for environmental monitoring at a finer scale.
summary.method: R4ATPRK was developed using the R language and several R packages.
